questions.question: [Purpose of Business and Enterprise] Explain the difference between a need and a want, giving two examples of each.
questions.correctAnswer: A need is essential for survival (food, water, shelter, clothing). A want is desirable but not essential (mobile phone, holiday, branded clothing). Needs are limited; wants are unlimited - this creates the basic economic problem of scarcity.
questions.explanation: A need is essential for survival (food, water, shelter, clothing). A want is desirable but not essential (mobile phone, holiday, branded clothing). Needs are limited; wants are unlimited - this creates the basic economic problem of scarcity.

questions.correctAnswer: Currently using job production (bespoke). Expanding nationwide online requires: higher volume, consistent quality, lower unit costs. questions.question: [Quality] Explain the difference between quality control and quality assurance.
questions.correctAnswer: Quality control checks products AFTER production to find and remove defective items - it's a checkpoint at the end. Quality assurance builds quality INTO the process at every stage, checking throughout so defects are prevented, not just detected. QC = catching problems; QA = preventing problems.
